title: Brunch Hash
ingredients: 1 medium white potato (about 200g), peeled and cubed
2 smoked back bacon rashers, fat removed, finely chopped
1 medium sweet potato (about 200g), peeled and cubed
½ red pepper, deseeded and cubed
steps: Spray a sauté pan with cooking spray over high heat. Add white potato and stir-fry 5 minutes until starting to brown.
Add onion and bacon; reduce heat slightly; stir-fry 5 more minutes.
Add sweet potato and pepper; spray top with more cooking spray; cook on medium for 20 minutes, stirring regularly.
Push vegetables aside to create 2 hollows. Crack an egg into each.
Season; cover with a lid and fry 4 minutes until whites are set and yolks still runny.
Serve immediately with your favourite sauce.
notes: Make vegetarian by omitting bacon and adding mushrooms and tomatoes. Torn mozzarella added with the eggs also works well.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
